items.source: Create a new DefaultConversionService with the set of default converters.
items.translation: 创建一个新的DefaultConversionService，包含一组默认转换器。

items.source: converterRegistry - the registry of converters to add to (must also be castable to ConversionService, for example, being a ConfigurableConversionService)
items.translation: converterRegistry - 要添加的转换器注册表（还必须可转换为 ConversionService，例如是 ConfigurableConversionService)

items.source: ClassCastException - if the given ConverterRegistry could not be cast to a ConversionService
items.translation: ClassCastException - 如果给定的 ConverterRegistry 无法转换为 ConversionService

items.source: Designed for direct instantiation but also exposes the static addDefaultConverters(ConverterRegistry) utility method for ad-hoc use against any ConverterRegistry instance.
items.translation: 专为直接实例化而设计，同时也公开了静态addDefaultConverters(ConverterRegistry)实用方法，可用于针对任何ConverterRegistry 实例进行临时使用。

items.source: NOTE: We highly recommend constructing individual ConversionService instances for customization purposes. This accessor is only meant as a fallback for code paths which need simple type coercion but cannot access a longer-lived ConversionService instance any other way.
items.translation: 注意：我们强烈建议为自定义目的构建独立的ConversionService实例。此访问器仅作为回退方案，适用于需要简单类型转换但无法通过其他方式访问长期存在的ConversionService实例的代码路径。

items.source: Add converters appropriate for most environments.
items.translation: 添加适用于大多数环境的转换器。
共享的ConversionService 实例（永远不为null）

items.source: Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll

items.source: Return a shared default ConversionService instance, lazily building it once needed.
items.translation: 返回一个共享的默认ConversionService实例，并在需要时懒加载构建。
